observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with 'Nikon' logo on top and 'D3300' on the front right. The lens is labeled 'NIKKOR AF-S DX 18-55G'. The camera is placed on a white crumpled paper with 'McSteve' branding.
Photo 1: Side view showing the lens with focus and zoom rings, and the 'D3300' model name on the camera body. A black and yellow strap is attached to the camera.

Photo 2: Top view showing the camera's top panel, including the mode dial, shutter button, and a small red indicator light. The lens is attached, and the camera appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or major dents.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MCSTEVE' and the same store branding on the surface.
The camera body appears clean with no obvious damage, but no internal or functional proof is shown.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D3300 DSLR camera with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the 'Nikon' logo and 'D3300' model name on the camera body, and the lens is labeled 'NIKKOR AF-S DX 18-55G'.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in use. No screen, shutter actuation, or menu navigation is visible. The red indicator light in photo 2 may suggest power, but not functionality.
The lens glass is not shown in close-up. The seller's text is incomplete and unclear. No close-up of the lens elements is provided.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal scratches, fungus, or haze not visible in the photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the front and rear lens elements, especially the corners and edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential optical defects

risks.risk: The camera may have internal damage or missing components (e.g., battery, charger, strap, or accessories)

proof_requests: Video of the camera turning on and taking a photo with the lens.
Close-up photo or video of the lens glass (front and rear).
Photo showing the battery, charger, and all accessories included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
